source.description: Three synthetic CN_A and US_EQUITY sessions per market to prove missed-window re-evaluation followed by two independently scoped FakeBroker execution days.
source.license: Internal synthetic simulation schedule; not a complete exchange calendar.

semantics.timezone: Per-session IANA timezone; open and close values are local wall-clock Fixture instants.
semantics.prices: No prices or market data; the existing AUTO order input remains a separate fixed Fixture.

sessions.calendar: Three explicitly listed synthetic sessions per market; the first AUTO window is missed and sessions two and three each create a new scoped proposal and mandate before simulated close reconciliation.

qualityCases: exactly three ordered sessions per market with distinct local timezones
each session close resolves strictly after its open
no order is created for a missed first session
AUTO execution occurs in sessions two and three after fresh session-scoped Proposals and Mandates
each session close reconciliation reads actual Portfolio and independent FakeBroker facts

expectedAssertions.description: The first session is marked MISSED_WINDOW with no stale order; each of the next two sessions receives a distinct Proposal, Mandate, order and Fill, followed by independent Portfolio/FakeBroker reconciliation before close.
